original.description: Under NAVISP Element 2, the Agency issues this permanently open Standard Call for Proposals without procurement, using Cooperative Agreements as contractual instrument.This Standard Call for Proposals without procurement aims to enhance Participant States' industrial competitiveness in the evolving Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) sector. Industry is invited to submit proposals to develop innovative and competitive PNT-related products. The Agency accepts proposals from both space and non-space companies, including large companies, mid-caps, small enterprises, and start-ups. Proposed products may address the satellite space segment, ground infrastructure, and user segment, including applications and services. Industry and research institutes of Participant States are encouraged to contact the NAVISP Element 2 team to discuss the development of pre-operational products aligned with their strategiesand plans. Details on the tendering process and how to prepare the Full Proposal are provided in the Standard Call for Proposals without procurement documentation.

original.description: The activities in GSTP Element 2 "Make" aim to strengthen worldwide competitiveness in the near term in existing markets, establish strategic capabilities which will result in stronger competitiveness in the medium term on existing or new markets, and to support the implementation of National priorities. GSTP Element 2 "Make" aims to support design, development, and demonstration activities. Products and technologies are defined to be any hardware, software, or applications within the scope set out in section 3 below. Key characteristics of this Element are:  The role of industry in defining and proposing projects oriented to commercial or institutional opportunities in all areas of satellite applications except satellite telecommunication (not covered by GSTP);  The outcome of an activity will eventually become a product ready for exploitation.  The sharing of funding by ESA and industry. Activities submitted in the frame of GSTP Element 2 Make" may be related to the improvement or development of satellite subsystems or equipment (including EGSE), space transportation subsystems or equipment up to engineering model or qualification model, and the improvement or development of ground / user system and equipment up to prototypes and commercialized products. Activities should address any the following technology themes: Earth observation, science, exploration, human spaceflight, space transportation, satellite navigation or generic technologies.

While it is made visible to all ESA Member States, Associate Members and European Cooperating States, this CfP will be addressed only to Slovenian legal entities registered in ESA-STAR, as prime tenderer and foresees the following standard activity types:Type A Research and Preparatory Activities, aimed at the preparation for participation in ESA optional programmes or the initial steps of a product development for Space, with potential for use on futureESA missions or commercial missions. The start TRL shall be at least 1 and the target TRL shall be TRL 3 or below. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 150,000.Type B Flight- and Ground Segment-related Research and Development Activities, targetting equipment to build competences and capabilities centred on products or generic technology development with potential for re-use on ESA or commercial missions. The start TRL shall be at least 3 and the target TRL shall be TRL 5. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 400 000 (flight related)/EUR 300 000 (ground related).Type C Flight Opportunities for mature existing Slovenian technologies or products in collaboration with experienced European players, to be involved in non-ESA mission in order to become flight proven. The start TRL shall be at least 5 and the target TRL shall be TRL 9. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 750 000 (inc. launch and operation cost). The work carried out by the Tenderer must be co-funded to a minimum level of 25% of the total cost of the activity. Maximum 20% of the budget may be assigned tonon-Slovenian entities, however launch and integration tasks are excluded from this limitation.Type D Space science activities, supporting the involvement of national researchers leading to potential of future involvement in ESA science mission core team and publication of peer reviewed scientific papers. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 100,000.Type F Space Applications, products and services making use of ESA/ European space infrastructure that is already existing or scheduled for operation in the near term. The start TRLshall be at least 6 and the target TRL shall be TRL 8. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 200,000. The work carried out by the Tenderer must be co-funded to a minimum level of 25% of the total cost of the activity.Type G1 University courses/modules leading to a qualification (BSc or MSc) in space related topics that correspond to the needs of national space industry and to encourage career in spaceandanswer to national space industry needs. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 70,000.To be published as a separate tender in esa-star: TypeG2 PhD Theses that correspond to a clear need from the national space industry and would lead to a new product or service beingableto be developed. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 70,000 with a minimum company co-funding of EUR 10,000. To be published in the Open Space Innovation Platform (OSIP, https://ideas.esa.int/): Type H  Space Related Training Courses, for the cost reimbursement of participation of employees in space related training courses. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 9,999. More information and further programmatic constraints can be consulted in the cover letter of the call upon its issue date.
